<!-- Adding or updating a pack: one file per pack in packs/<id>.json -->

- [ ] The repository is public and has a release whose only `.vitrine` asset is the pack.
- [ ] `id` and `version` in `vitrine.json` match the store entry and the release tag.
- [ ] Every widget has a `preview` image.
- [ ] Permissions are the minimum the widgets need, and the README says why network hosts are used.
- [ ] I have the right to distribute everything in the pack (code, fonts, images).
